name: hero-typographic
title: Typographic hero
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A large statement headline with one accented phrase, an optional lede and actions, and a ruled row of short facts.

meta.useWhen: The positioning sentence is the strongest material, or there is no imagery yet.
meta.avoidWhen: The headline runs past about fourteen words, or a photo of the real work would say more.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/HeroTypographic.astro. Set emphasis to a phrase that appears in title.
